audience: email marketers who manage subscribers and newsletters in MailerLite

useCases.title: Find subscribers by status or look one up
useCases.text: The AI lists subscribers filtered by status, for example unsubscribed or bounced, or fetches one subscriber by id or email address.

useCases.title: See your groups and who is in each one
useCases.text: The AI lists groups, can filter them by name, and lists the subscribers of a group by status. You see how big each list is.

useCases.title: Review your campaigns by status
useCases.text: The AI lists campaigns filtered by status and reads the details of one campaign. This server does not send campaigns.

useCases.title: Add or update a subscriber
useCases.text: The AI creates a subscriber or updates an existing one by email address. It does not send any email.

useCases.title: Create a group and add subscribers to it
useCases.text: The AI creates a new subscriber group and adds a subscriber to a group. Memberships are only added, never removed.

useCases.title: Check your fields, segments, automations and webhooks
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriber fields, segments, automations (with enabled state) and webhooks. You see how the account is set up.
